question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Human beings also have roots, but unlike trees, these roots are (a) ------- and lie deep in our minds. They connect us with our families, relatives, traditions, and the (b) ------- where we were born and raised. These roots shape our identity and give us a sense of (c) -------. No matter where we go, we feel a constant (d) ------- towards them. But when we lose this connection, we feel empty and (e) ----- --, like we no longer belong anywhere. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) invisible; (b) land; (c) self; (d) pull; (e) rootless; ● st ●
